caption: The drawing depicts a tall grandfather clock composed primarily of a wooden case with rich brown and reddish hues, and some gold detailing, including outlining and decorative accents. The clock is rectangular, standing upright, and has a slightly ornate pediment at the top, featuring a small finial and two scroll-like details. The main body of the clock is divided into three sections: the upper section houses the clock face; the central section, which is the longest, has marquetry-style decorative oval and circular inlays outlined in gold; and the lower section, wider at the base, features diamond-shaped inlays. The clock face is circular, white, with black Roman numerals, and a pair of black clock hands. Above the face is a painted semicircular arch, within which appears a small portrait of a person with a white background. The entire clock is set against a plain, light beige background with no other objects present.
title: Grandfather Clock (Timepiece)
